Aarav Sharma, 98765 43210
Riya Gupta, 98765 00000, Neha Gupta

consent.on: The parent agreed: fee reminders, absence alerts and notices go to this number.
consent.off: Turned off: no automatic WhatsApp messages to this number.
consent.unknown: Not asked yet: no automatic WhatsApp messages until the parent agrees.
consent.stoppedEverywhere: The parent replied STOP on WhatsApp: no automatic messages until they send START.
consent.confirmBody: Turn this on only if the parent said yes to getting fee reminders, absence alerts and notices on WhatsApp.
